description: This file defines an abstract controller class for handling Vue.js components within a PHP web application, specifically within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It manages rendering Vue components using Twig templates, handling request lifecycle events, and integrating with the framework's response and request objects.

classes.name: AbstractVueController
classes.description: An abstract controller class for rendering Vue.js components in a web application, handling lifecycle events and integration with Twig templating.

methods.name: setTwig
methods.description: Sets the Twig Environment instance for rendering templates.

methods.name: getTwig
methods.description: Retrieves the current Twig Environment instance.

methods.name: setTemplate
methods.description: Sets the template filename used for rendering.

methods.name: setComponent
methods.description: Sets the Vue component to be rendered; throws exception if already handled.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Retrieves the Vue component to be rendered.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the controller, meant to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Hook method called before rendering, can be overridden.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the Vue component using Twig and returns the output string.

methods.name: postRender
methods.description: Hook method called after rendering, can be overridden.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method to handle the request, coordinate preRender, render, postRender, and response creation.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the AttributeBag for storing rendering context data.

methods.name: handleBadRequest
methods.description: Handles bad request scenarios, setting a 'bad-request' component.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the response object and marks the request as handled.

methods.name: isHandled
methods.description: Checks whether the request has been handled.

methods.name: setHandled
methods.description: Marks the request as handled or not.
